name: 2server
description: Deploy and operate your infrastructure with 2srv, a 2found tool.

interface.longDescription: Use the installed 2srv CLI to deploy apps, manage domains and named service templates, and recover VM-owned configuration. Requires Bun, Node and @2server/cli on the operator's machine; installs instructions only, without provisioning resources.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $2server to inspect the target and plan the requested infrastructure operation.
